text: SUPERVISOR — discoverability FAIL on your item source, fold into your queue: the user could not find voxel authoring at all ("i see the sculpting part but what about the voxel stacking part"). Fix: the path INTO voxel authoring must be discoverable even with an empty roster — e.g. the +New flow lands somewhere the ITEM/SCULPT/VOXEL lens switch is immediately visible, and/or a "+ Voxel blockout" affordance sits next to +New. The user looking at the ITEMS panel and knowing where to stack voxels is the PASS.
